messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Handed to the team · Only Abel or Georges can issue the refund; customer has followed up three times.

I've put it straight back to Abel and Georges with the detail of what was promised on October 5. They're on until 6pm ET, so one of them can pick this up here in the chat. If you step away, the confirmation goes to (email hidden)

I hope that you included the shipping dates originally provided back when the order was made on 07/31/2026, and or the shipping date provided shortly thereafter on 08/4/2026, or at least the difference.

This picture is from the 08/04/2026 email from you, including the shipping date "as i gave it."

Nothing else on the order changes while they sort the money.
